title: Timeless Square Crochet Blanket Pattern - PDF Digital Download
description:
An instant-download PDF crochet pattern for the Timeless Square blanket.

WHAT YOU GET
- 12-page PDF with written instructions and stitch photos

- Yarn weight, hook size and gauge notes
